source_rule: Drafted only from canonical Candidate Truth claims/evidence plus the explicitly authorized pinned LoanIQ and Market Empire evidence added in this branch. Prior generated resumes are not evidence.

bullets.text: Prepared structured financial reports in Excel for Bulgarian National Bank submission and reconciled 1,000+ monthly transactions.
Extracted and processed data for daily, weekly, and monthly reporting to Bulgarian National Bank requirements.
Built a Python/Streamlit coffee-shop market-screening prototype with explicit limits on predictive and business-success claims.
Separated deterministic screening scores from an optional LLM narrative layer that cannot change official scores, thresholds, status, or scenario calculations.
Integrated Google Places nearby-search and U.S. Census ACS demographic feeds into the MarketMind screening workflow.
Implemented a 3.5-mile geofence, a 50-request local daily counter, and retry with degraded fallback for external data failures.
Built an automated pytest validation suite covering the MarketMind screening pipeline.
Reviewed 500+ user cases weekly against platform policy, identifying violations and behavioral patterns across structured and unstructured data.
Tracked and categorized enforcement decisions for trend analysis and consistency, collaborating across policy, operations, and analytics teams.
Defined an internal Google Workspace operating tool with explicit scope boundaries before implementation.
Built send controls that stop live follow-up email when the master kill switch is on, test mode is on, or live follow-ups are not allowed.
Built Drive-folder CSV intake into Workbook A with automated import logging for Success, Held, and Failed run states.
Automated mapping of self-report responses into an Evidence_Log and synchronized approved updates into an Adoption_Matrix with audit logging.
Documented pilot and UAT results across ten PASS test rows covering import validation, PII checks, applicability checks, and related scenarios.
Mapped a manual support workflow into a structured process covering evidence tracking, review, follow-up, and human approval.
Built Excel reports for expenses, revenues, and cash flows and managed monthly budget/cash-flow reporting of approximately $80K.
Used SQLite and SQL feature engineering to create a model_features view with derived ratios and flags for the LoanIQ credit-risk research prototype.
Built LoanIQ, a Python/Pandas/SQLite/XGBoost credit-risk research prototype with Streamlit delivery and explicit production/regulatory limits.
Built a React/TypeScript financial-education demo with deterministic financial logic, Vitest and Playwright coverage, and Vercel deployment.
